title: Dr. Goon + Fem-Goon: battle idle OPTIONS (FFX-2 only, Chapter VI Act I). Candidates, nothing installed
subtitle: Pick one per goon, or a matched pair (A/A, B/B, C/C). Whole figures at 0.42x, the same scale as the trio's locked idles; faces at 1:1 native pixels; in-battle crops at 1:1 from a 1600x900 frame (RTX 5070 Ti, D3D11).
research: "Goons: masks and skin-tight suits; pink for the women, army green for the men." (sec 10.1, verified: 2 sources)
Act I: "Ormi #220 ... + Dr. Goon (232 HP) + Fem-Goon (167 HP)" (sec 4). Dr. Goon: "Strike (physical, single)". Fem-Goon: the four elements and "Fan Slap" (sec 4.6).
"The Syndicate heart: the one shape that appears at every scale" (sec 10.2, interpretive).
Not in the sources: the mask's shape, how much face shows, hair, build. A/B/C vary exactly those; every option keeps the suit colours and the heart.

rows.title: Dr. Goon
rows.note: army green suit, mask (sec 10.1). In battle every option stands 95 to 104 px tall against Ormi 123 px: the engine scale for the goons, not the art, sets that.

options.label: A
options.name: Full balaclava
options.line: Full olive balaclava, fists up in a boxer's guard: the most faceless henchman. Pixel repair, no re-render: the tan loincloth is recoloured to a suit-olive waist sash and the bead necklace is painted out. The mask is a shade darker than the suit.

options.label: B
options.name: Hood + face mask
options.line: Olive hood and cloth mask over nose and mouth, eyes showing; low brawler stance. Extras the sources do not give are kept as rendered: a front cloth tabard, a brown belt buckle, heeled boots.

options.label: C
options.name: Domino mask, face shown
options.line: Black domino mask, dark hair, cocky grin, hand on hip: the most personality and the least masked. Very muscular (the sources give no build). Nearly front-on, so the engine's mirror matters least.

rows.title: Fem-Goon
rows.note: pink suit, mask (sec 10.1); casts elements, Fan Slap (sec 4.6)

options.label: A
options.name: Full balaclava
options.line: Full pink balaclava with a heart on the brow, hand on hip; pairs with Dr. Goon A. The pink runs hot magenta, stronger than the other two.

options.label: B
options.name: Hood + face mask
options.line: Pink hood and cloth mask, hand at the hood; pairs with Dr. Goon B. Pixel repair, no re-render: the white face mask, white chest panel and blue arm bands are recoloured to the suit pink. Flag: the chest emblem is a red splash, not a clean heart.

options.label: C
options.name: Domino mask, bob, fan
options.line: Brown bob, pink domino mask, closed fan held at the chin (a nod to Fan Slap; the fan itself is not sourced), heart on the upper arm; pairs with Dr. Goon C.
